text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr delivered a magnificent 
performance. She seemed fully convinced 
that only in the Twinkle Series could her 
dream of becoming the wind come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the academy, the two 
discussed their future plans. Eager to 
catch up to the "Emperor of the Mile," she 
insisted on pursuing the mile route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that case, while focusing on mile 
races, you should also enter sprint races 
to polish your speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, take the time to properly build up 
her body. The next goal is the spring 
graded race, the New Zealand Trophy. After 
talking it over, that is what the two 
decided.
